definition.en: A traditional definition of corruption is the abuse of public office for personal gain.
definition.zh: 对腐败的一个传统定义是：滥用公权力以谋取私利。

definition.en: In fact, I didn’t really even know the legal definition of car in Japanese.
definition.zh: 事实上，我甚至不知道日语中“汽车”的法律定义是什么。

definition.en: OPEC fits this definition because its member countries coordinate how much oil they produce.
definition.zh: OPEC符合这个定义，因为其成员国会协调各自的石油产量。

definition.en: But unlike many Hindus and Buddhists, Jains' definition of non-violence includes plants and vegetables.
definition.zh: 但与许多印度教徒和佛教徒不同，耆那教对非暴力的定义包括植物和蔬菜。

definition.en: Some people argue that later European works fit the definition of a novel more clearly.
definition.zh: 一些人认为后来的欧洲作品更清楚地符合小说的定义。

definitely.en: It’s a pretty depressing word, but one that definitely captured the feeling of the time.
definitely.zh: 这是一个相当令人沮丧的词，但它确实精准地捕捉到了那个时代的情绪。

definitely.en: My mom's definitely remarkable. But as she would say, it's by the grace of God.
definitely.zh: 我妈妈确实很了不起。但正如她所说，那是上帝的恩典。

definitely.en: I couldn't give you a word, but you definitely march to your own drum.
definitely.zh: 我找不出一个词来形容你，但你绝对是走自己的路。

definitely.en: Do English tests improve education? English tests definitely have an important purpose.
definitely.zh: 英语考试能改善教育吗？英语考试绝对有其重要的目的。

definitely.en: Well, the answer is potentially yes. Not definitely yes, but potentially yes.
definitely.zh: 嗯，答案是潜在的会。不是绝对会，但潜在的会。

describe.en: Annabel describes ultra-processed foods as things containing ingredients you wouldn't find in your kitchen.
describe.zh: Annabel将超加工食品描述为包含你在厨房里找不到的成分的东西。

describe.en: The adjective visual describes things related to seeing, while auditory means related to hearing.
describe.zh: 形容词 visual 用来描述与视觉相关的事物，而 auditory 意思是与听觉相关的。

describe.en: Bandura described four different sources of self-efficacy, four ways you can build your self-efficacy.
describe.zh: 班杜拉描述了自我效能的四个不同来源，即你可以建立自我效能的四种方式。

describe.en: The adjective, manipulative, describes trying to influence or control someone to your own advantage.
describe.zh: 形容词“操纵性的”描述的是试图为了你自己的利益去影响或控制某人。

describe.en: The phrase, one-size-fits-all, describes trying to apply the same solution to many different problems.
describe.zh: “一刀切”这个短语描述的是试图将相同的解决方案应用于许多不同的问题。

detail.en: And the thing that makes it memorable is the zooming in on a detail.
detail.zh: 让它变得令人难忘的是对细节的放大。

detail.en: His death is widely believed to have been suicide, though some details remain debated.
detail.zh: 人们普遍认为他的死是自杀，尽管一些细节仍存争议。

detail.en: If you unpack an idea or scientific concept, you explain it in clear detail.
detail.zh: 如果你 unpack 一个想法或科学概念，意思就是详细清楚地解释它。

detail.en: Let’s take a more detailed look at the history and development of the EU.
detail.zh: 让我们更详细地了解一下欧盟的历史和发展。

detail.en: If you dig up information about someone, you try to find details about them.
detail.zh: 如果你 dig up 某人的信息，你就是在试图寻找关于他们的细节。

deliberately.en: Much of Singapore’s environment was deliberately planned by the state.
deliberately.zh: 新加坡的许多环境都是由国家刻意规划的。

deliberately.en: And those principles would be deliberately, intentionally harsh.
deliberately.zh: 而这些原则将是蓄意的、故意地严厉。

deliberately.en: They were skilled seafarers and they deliberately chose to settle on one of the most remote islands in the world.
deliberately.zh: 他们是熟练的航海家，并且是故意选择在世界上最偏远的岛屿之一定居的。

deliberately.en: Deliberately looking for rejection might be an extreme way to become more confident, but it can lead to surprising discoveries.
deliberately.zh: 故意寻求拒绝也许是建立自信的一种极端方式，但它可能会带来令人惊喜的发现。

deliberately.en: He deliberately placed his most lightly-armoured troops, mostly Gauls, whom the Romans viewed as fierce but undisciplined warriors, in the centre of his line.
deliberately.zh: 他故意将自己最薄弱的部队——主要是被罗马人视为凶猛但缺乏纪律的高卢人——部署在阵型的中央。

depend.en: This same behavior, “being late “, can have completely different meanings depending on the culture.
depend.zh: 同样的“迟到”行为，根据文化的不同，可能会有完全截然相反的含义。

depend.en: In other words, climate models are conditional, meaning that they depend on other factors.
depend.zh: 换句话说，气候模型是有条件的，这意味着它们取决于其他因素。

depend.en: And finally, in Korea, how you say sorry depends on who you're apologising to.
depend.zh: 最后，在韩国，你怎么说对不起取决于你要向谁道歉。

depend.en: Instead, they make projections about different possible futures, and these depend on many things.
depend.zh: 相反，它们对各种可能的未来做出预估，而这些预估取决于许多因素。

depend.en: Hmm... Reasonably good, I suppose. It depends what kind of event we're talking about.
depend.zh: 嗯……我想还算不错吧。这取决于我们说的是哪种事件。

destructive.en: As the world warms, climate scientists think that these storms will get more destructive.
destructive.zh: 随着世界变暖，气候科学家认为这些风暴将变得更具破坏性。

destructive.en: Right? That's entrepreneurship. Sure. It creates absolutely nothing and probably is net destructive, right?
destructive.zh: 对吧？那也是一种企业家行为。没错。它什么都没创造出来，甚至很可能是净破坏性的，对吧？

destructive.en: That's punking the game in a way that I think is destructive both externally and internally.
destructive.zh: 他们可以大笑，你知道，因为他们不想面对对话中这部分的不适感。

destructive.en: For in the destructive potential of the atomic bomb lay opportunity.
destructive.zh: 因为在原子弹的毁灭潜力中，蕴含着机遇。

destructive.en: The Yellow Rivers floods were sometimes violent and destructive.
destructive.zh: 黄河的洪水有时是暴力且具有破坏性的。

destroy.en: The Spanish had destroyed the Aztec drainage system and filled in the Aztec canals.
destroy.zh: 西班牙人摧毁了阿兹特克的排水系统，并填平了阿兹特克的运河。

destroy.en: Soon after democracy was dismantled, destroyed, and Germany was transformed into a totalitarian state.
destroy.zh: 不久之后，民主被拆除、摧毁，德国被改造为一个极权国家。

destroy.en: I'm like, oh. Here I was thinking I was going to be completely destroyed.
destroy.zh: 我想，噢。我还以为自己会被彻底毁灭呢。

destroy.en: Cities destroyed in an instant, tens, if not hundreds of thousands dead.
destroy.zh: 城市瞬间被毁，成千上万甚至数十万人丧生。

destroy.en: By the end of the war, around 85% of Warsaw had been destroyed.
destroy.zh: 到战争结束时，大约 85% 的华沙已被摧毁。

degree.en: These are jobs that require training and experience, but not necessarily a university degree.
degree.zh: 这些工作需要培训和经验，但不一定需要大学学位。

degree.en: I started to study Chinese in 2018 when I was doing my master’s degree.
degree.zh: 我在2018年读硕士学位时开始学中文。

degree.en: The noun liveability means the degree to which a place is pleasant to live in.
degree.zh: 名词“宜居性”指一个地方适合居住的舒适程度。

degree.en: He graduated in 2009 with the highest honours, with a degree in political science and philosophy.
degree.zh: 他在2009年以最高荣誉毕业，获得了政治学和哲学学位。

degree.en: There are still job shortages where sponsorship is possible even without degrees.
degree.zh: 仍然存在即使没有学位也可以进行担保的人才短缺岗位。

destruction.en: After defeating the resistance the German army carried out a near total destruction of Warsaw.
destruction.zh: 在击溃抵抗力量后，德军对华沙实施了近乎彻底的毁灭。

destruction.en: I need to save myself from eternal destruction." All the stuff he used to believe.
destruction.zh: 我需要拯救自己免于永恒的毁灭。”所有这些他曾经深信不疑的东西。

destruction.en: An apocalypse refers to a serious event which causes destruction and change.
destruction.zh: Apocalypse（世界末日）是指导致破坏和变革的严重事件。

destruction.en: An apocalypse refers to a serious event which causes destruction and change.
destruction.zh: Apocalypse（世界末日）是指导致破坏和变革的严重事件。

destruction.en: A storm surge is a sudden rise in the sea level, that can move inland causing destruction.
destruction.zh: “Storm surge”（风暴潮）是海平面的突然上升，可以向内陆移动并造成破坏。

dedicate.en: You can put your full focus and dedicate yourself to one target: passing that test.
dedicate.zh: 你可以集中全部精力，致力于一个目标：通过那个考试。

dedicate.en: Unfortunately, I didn’t dedicate enough time to study at all, so I failed.
dedicate.zh: 不幸的是，我根本没有投入足够的时间学习，所以我失败了。

dedicate.en: Rebecca says that our brains haven't evolved to include a dedicated reading brain.
dedicate.zh: 丽贝卡说，我们的大脑并未进化到包含一个专门的阅读大脑。

dedicate.en: Dedicated can describe something that is designed and used for one particular purpose.
dedicate.zh: “专门的”（dedicated）可以描述为某种特定目的设计和使用的东西。

dedicate.en: Along with other European languages, English doesn't have much vocabulary dedicated to the different qualities of actual smells.
dedicate.zh: 和其他一些欧洲语言一样，英语中专门用来描述实际气味不同特质的词汇并不多。

deal.en: More buildings and churches and facilities were built to deal with the growing population.
deal.zh: 为了应对不断增长的人口，更多的建筑、教堂和设施拔地而起。

deal.en: Microsoft has signed a deal to buy fusion electricity from a company called Helion by 2028.
deal.zh: Microsoft 已经签署了一项协议，到2028年从一家名为 Helion 的公司购买核聚变电力。

deal.en: We had confront something. That is to meet with it or deal with it.
deal.zh: 我们学了 confront something。那是直面或应对它。

deal.en: If you can't handle something, you find it difficult to deal or cope with.
deal.zh: 如果你无法应对（can't handle）某事，你会发现很难处理或应付它。

deal.en: Yeah. And then like on TikTok, hey, how did you deal with your ADHD?
deal.zh: 是的。然后像在TikTok上，‘嘿，你是怎么处理你的ADHD的？’

decision.en: These countries cooperate on decisions, even if they’re not officially part of OPEC itself.
decision.zh: 这些国家在决策上进行合作，即使它们并非OPEC本身的正式成员。

decision.en: This was a deliberate decision. It kept the peace between branches of the family.
decision.zh: 这是一个深思熟虑的决定。它维系了王室各支派之间的和平。

decision.en: It is the direct result of decisions made just over a hundred years ago.
decision.zh: 它是 100 多年前所做决定的直接结果。

decision.en: Next one. The heaviest things in life aren't iron and gold, but unmade decisions.
decision.zh: 下一个。生活中最重的负担不是铁块和黄金，而是未做出的决定。

decision.en: Human behavior and emotions and decision making don’t change as quickly as technology does.
decision.zh: 人类的行为、情绪和决策并不像技术那样变化得那么快。

depress.en: It’s a pretty depressing word, but one that definitely captured the feeling of the time.
depress.zh: 这是一个相当令人沮丧的词，但它确实精准地捕捉到了那个时代的情绪。

depress.en: If you say, I'm a depressed, unhappy person, yeah, I'm going to be unhappy.
depress.zh: 如果你说，我是一个抑郁、不快乐的人，是的，我会不快乐。

depress.en: If all this sounds a bit depressing. Kate's final message is more hopeful.
depress.zh: 如果所有这些听起来有点让人沮丧，Kate的最后传达的信息则更有希望。

depress.en: And this felt like the most depressing theme park experience we'd ever had.
depress.zh: 这感觉像是我们经历过的最令人沮丧的主题公园体验。

depress.en: But I remember being confused because I was like, I'm not depressed perpetually, but I definitely experienced these moments.
depress.zh: 但我记得我很困惑，因为我当时想，我不是永久抑郁，但我确实经历了这些时刻。

debate.en: Historians still debate today why the Soviet Army didn’t help the people of Warsaw.
debate.zh: 时至今日，历史学家仍在争论苏军当年为何不肯帮助华沙人民。

debate.en: His death is widely believed to have been suicide, though some details remain debated.
debate.zh: 人们普遍认为他的死是自杀，尽管一些细节仍存争议。

debate.en: Whether they feared arrest or were seeking military support from abroad, historians still debate.
debate.zh: 历史学家们至今仍在争论他们是因为害怕被捕，还是为了在国外寻求军事支持。

debate.en: And there are now many debates over immigration, identity, climate change, and economic growth.​
debate.zh: 如今围绕移民、身份认同、气候变化和经济增长也存在着许多辩论。​

debate.en: And their official documents, like passports or parliamentary debates, are available in both languages.
debate.zh: 他们的官方文件，比如护照或议会辩论记录，都有这两种语言的版本。

descend.en: It was an unstable empire as well. Soon, Europe descended into conflict.
descend.zh: 这也是一个不稳定的帝国。很快，欧洲陷入了冲突。

descend.en: Oh, well, that's an extra special level of hell that you've descended into.
descend.zh: 哦，好吧，那是你坠入的另一个特殊层级的地狱。

descend.en: But against all odds, they made it. And what Hannibal found when he descended into northern Italy was… opportunity.
descend.zh: 但历经千难万险，他们成功了。当Hannibal率军降临意大利北部时，他发现的是……机遇。

descend.en: Now, this was in the early 20th century, and just as his obsession was reaching a fever pitch, Europe descended into the chaos of the First World War.
descend.zh: 当时正值 20 世纪初，正当他对这件事的痴迷达到狂热顶点时，欧洲陷入了一战的混乱之中。

descend.en: One of the most famous legends linked this invention to Alexander the Great, who supposedly descended underwater in a glass bell alongside a few animal companions —a dog, a cat, and even a chicken.
descend.zh: 最著名的传说之一将这项发明与亚历山大大帝联系在一起，据称他曾和一个动物伙伴——一只狗、一只猫甚至一只鸡——一起乘着玻璃钟潜入水下。

decade.en: To many ordinary people, the old elite had lived above the law for decades.
decade.zh: 对许多普通人来说，老一代精英几十年来一直凌驾于法律之上。

decade.en: For decades, there were basically only two political parties people voted for: Labour, Conservatives.
decade.zh: 几十年来，人们基本上只有两个政党可以投票：工党和保守党。

decade.en: This one ran safely for decades, and only closed in 2019, for ordinary financial reasons.
decade.zh: 这一个反应堆安全运行了数十年，直到2019年才因普通的财务原因关闭。

decade.en: But the PAP maintains an overwhelming amount of political power and dominance for decades.
decade.zh: 但人民行动党在几十年来一直保持着压倒性的政治权力和统治地位。

decade.en: I have spoken to hundreds, maybe even thousands, of English learners over the past decade.
decade.zh: 在过去的十年里，我和成百上千、甚至可能上万名英语学习者交谈过。

desire.en: If there’s an appetite for something, there’s a strong desire or demand for it.
desire.zh: 如果对某事有 appetite（渴望），说明有强烈的欲望或需求。

desire.en: I think we have a lot of unnecessary desires that we just pick up everywhere.
desire.zh: 我认为我们有很多不必要的欲望，它们都是我们到处沾染来的。

desire.en: So when your mind is under stress, it's because it has two conflicting desires at once.
desire.zh: 所以当你的头脑处于压力下时，是因为它同时有两个相互冲突的渴望。

desire.en: An aphrodisiac is a food or drink believed to increase sexual desire.
desire.zh: Aphrodisiac是一种被认为能增加性欲的食物或饮料。

desire.en: Like the Ancient Greeks, Jains believe that garlic stimulates sexual desire.
desire.zh: 就像古希腊人一样，耆那教徒认为大蒜会刺激性欲。

despite.en: Day and night, people occupied the square, camping out despite the threat of violence.
despite.zh: 日以继夜，人们占领了广场，不顾暴力威胁在那里露营。

despite.en: Despite these benefits, testing, and English testing in particular, has plenty of critics.
despite.zh: 尽管有这些好处，测试，尤其是英语测试，也招来了大量的批评。

despite.en: Now, despite their decline, the condottieri left a lasting mark on the history of warfare.
despite.zh: 尽管走向衰落，condottieri 仍在战争史上留下了深刻的印记。

despite.en: Despite the difference in medical technology and communication, again the patterns are similar.
despite.zh: 尽管医疗技术和通讯手段有所不同，但模式再次相似。

despite.en: But despite his overwhelming lead, the tournament quickly spiraled into a master class in self-sabotage.
despite.zh: 但尽管遥遥领先，这场比赛却很快演变成了一堂关于自我毁灭的“大师课”。

detect.en: How can you test someone’s comprehension of a joke or their ability to detect sarcasm?
detect.zh: 你怎么能测试一个人对笑话的理解力或他们察觉讽刺的能力呢？

detect.en: She developed highly precise instruments to detect and measure radiation levels.
detect.zh: 她开发了高度精确的仪器来检测和测量辐射水平。

detect.en: But which part of the brain is best known for its role in processing fear and detecting threats?
detect.zh: 但是，大脑的哪个部分最以为人知的功能是处理恐惧和检测威胁？

detect.en: Well, by filtering out common non-threatening smells it makes it easier to detect things out of the ordinary that might be dangerous.
detect.zh: 嗯，通过过滤掉常见的没有威胁的气味，可以让人更容易检测到可能存在危险的不寻常事物。

detect.en: When we breathe in, receptor cells in the nose detect molecules in the air and send them to olfactory organs in the brain.
detect.zh: 当我们吸气时，鼻子里的受体细胞探测到空气中的分子，并将它们发送到大脑的嗅觉器官。

design.en: One reason for not updating tech is if the original design still works well.
design.zh: 不更新科技的一个原因，是最初的设计依然运行良好。

design.en: Another issue is questions designed to show intelligence rather than get an answer.
design.zh: 另一个问题是，有些提问的目的不是为了得到答案，而是为了炫耀智商。

design.en: These types of assessments are designed to help you, to help learners, improve.
design.zh: 这些类型的评估旨在帮助你、帮助学习者不断进步。

design.en: Their algorithms are designed to show users the posts most likely to attract their attention.
design.zh: 它们的算法旨在向用户展示最能吸引他们注意力的帖子。

design.en: It was designed for crowds to gather there and watch gladiator fights or animal hunts.
design.zh: 它旨在让民众聚集在那里观看角斗士决斗或猎兽表演。

destination.en: And when international tourists dream of visiting Brazil, Rio is usually their first destination.
destination.zh: 当国际游客梦想游览巴西时，里约通常是他们的第一目的地。

destination.en: Is the UK becoming a temporary study destination rather than a long-term opportunity?
destination.zh: 英国正在变成一个临时的学习目的地，而不是一个长期的发展机会吗？

destination.en: Our second destination is better known for cars than bicycles: the United Arab Emirates or UAE.
destination.zh: 我们的第二个目的地比起自行车，更以汽车闻名：阿拉伯联合酋长国，简称阿联酋。

destination.en: Well, as the final destination for much looted treasure, museums have an important role to play.
destination.zh: 嗯，作为许多被掠夺宝藏的最终目的地，博物馆扮演着重要的角色。

destination.en: Now, our second destination, Japan, also has a history of eating noodles.
destination.zh: 现在，我们的第二个目的地日本，也有吃面的历史。

device.en: To explore this, he invented an imaginary device, we now call the Turing Machine.
device.zh: 为了探讨这一点，他发明了一种假想的装置，我们现在称之为 Turing Machine。

device.en: In English, this device became known, as you now know, as a swazzle.
device.zh: 在英语中，这个装置正如你们现在所知，被称为 swazzle。

device.en: If you are using an Apple device, go to apple.co. slash hiddenbrain.
device.zh: 如果你使用的是苹果设备，请访问 apple.co 斜杠 hiddenbrain。

device.en: The men began to prime the device, setting a timer for 10 minutes.
device.zh: 两人开始给装置引信，设置了一个10分钟的定时器。

device.en: Screen time - that’s how much time you spend using devices like smart phones, tablets and laptops.
device.zh: 屏幕时间——也就是你使用智能手机、平板电脑和笔记本电脑等设备所花费的时间。

dentist.en: And some businesses can draw on this through things like endorsements – you know, dentists recommending toothpaste, athletes endorsing sportswear.
dentist.zh: 有些企业可以通过各种代言来利用这一点——你知道的，牙医推荐牙膏，运动员代言运动服。

dentist.en: Sharon remembered that one mentor, her husband was a dentist, and he fixed a mother's badly decayed teeth for free.
dentist.zh: Sharon记得有一个导师的丈夫是个牙医，他免费为一位母亲严重蛀坏的牙齿做了治疗。

dean.en: Here's product designer Dean Ward speaking to BBC World Service's Business Daily.
dean.zh: 这是产品设计师Dean Ward接受BBC世界服务部《商业日报》采访时的发言。

desert.en: Lawrence rode for days through the desert to deliver the news to British commanders in Cairo.
desert.zh: Lawrence 骑马在沙漠中奔波了数日，将消息传达给开罗的英国指挥官。

desert.en: There are dense forests, incredibly hot deserts, tropical wetlands and temperate planes.
desert.zh: 这里有茂密的森林、酷热的沙漠、热带湿地和温带平原。

desert.en: Aboriginal communities adapted to Australia’s deserts, wetlands, tropical regions, and temperate zones.
desert.zh: 原住民社群适应了澳大利亚的沙漠、湿地、热带地区和温带。

desert.en: The Ottomans lost battles on multiple fronts, from the deserts of Arabia to the mountains of the Caucasus.
desert.zh: 奥斯曼人在多个战线上失利，从阿拉伯的沙漠到高加索的山脉。

desert.en: It was partly practicality—the robes were more suited to the desert—but it was also a symbol.
desert.zh: 这部分是出于实用性——长袍更适合沙漠——但也是一种象征。

desperate.en: Parliament is desperate for the king to recover and is willing to try anything.
desperate.zh: 议会迫切希望国王康复，愿意尝试任何方法。

desperate.en: Are there similar stories of politicians getting into trouble and resorting to desperate measures in your country?
desperate.zh: 在你的国家，是否有类似的政治家陷入困境并采取极端手段的故事？

desperate.en: If you were desperate for work, and your employer knew it, they could pay you next to nothing.
desperate.zh: 如果你急需工作，而你的雇主又知道这一点，他们可以付给你极低的报酬。

desperate.en: When you're really desperate for something, you can focus on it so obsessively, there's no room for anything else.
desperate.zh: 当你极度渴望某样东西时，你可以执着到这种程度——以至于容不下其他任何东西。

desperate.en: Remember, they're desperate to get any kind of interest return.
desperate.zh: 记住，他们极度渴望获得任何形式的利息回报。

devour.en: It's the same meal every day, which the boys devour out of necessity.
devour.zh: 每天都是同样的饭菜，男孩们出于饥饿狼吞虎咽地吃光了。

devour.en: And the country that had once been feared and respected was on the chopping board, ready to be devoured by foreign enemies and powerless to do anything about it.
devour.zh: 这个曾经令人敬畏和尊重的国家正处于砧板上，准备被外国敌人吞噬，而它却无能为力。

declare.en: Perhaps he would even have declared something along the lines of “I am happy”.
declare.zh: 也许他甚至会发出“我很幸福”之类的感慨。

declare.en: He was drowning in debt, and was at risk of having to declare personal bankruptcy.
declare.zh: 他债台高筑，面临着不得不宣布个人破产的风险。

declare.en: "What?", he asks, before declaring that the boy will be hanged one day.
declare.zh: “什么？”他问道，接着断言这个男孩有一天会被绞死。

declare.en: My dad’s father declared him dead, sat shiva for him, never spoke to my father again.
declare.zh: 我父亲的父亲宣告他已经死亡，为他坐了哀悼期，从此再也没有跟我父亲说过话。

declare.en: But declaring independence and actually becoming independent are very different things.
declare.zh: 但宣布独立和真正实现独立是两码事。

despair.en: Never, never, never. So there was never despair on the other side that I could feel from my mom.
despair.zh: 永远，永远，永远。所以另一边从来没有我能从我妈妈那里感受到的绝望。

despair.en: But the boys, he wrote, could sense her despair.
despair.zh: 但他写道，孩子们能感觉到她的绝望。

delight.en: He delighted in seeing people squirm. Prisoners were executed in front of him for sport.
delight.zh: 他以看着别人痛苦挣扎为乐。囚犯们为了供他消遣而在他面前被处决。

delight.en: Thank you, Shankar. It was a delight for me, and I very much enjoyed our conversation, and I truly enjoy your show.
delight.zh: 谢谢你，Shankar。今天对我来说是一次愉快的经历，我非常享受我们的这次对话，也真心很喜欢你的节目。

delight.en: He reportedly once appeared in the theatre dressed as Venus, complete with wig and dress, delighting in the outrage of Rome’s conservative senators.
delight.zh: 据报道，他曾有一次打扮成 Venus 出现在剧院里，戴着假发穿着长袍，对罗马保守派元老院议员的愤怒感到洋洋得意。

delight.en: And then when he finished and opened his eyes and looked around, the whole place just went up in a roar where everyone was delighted, and half laughing, and half tearful.
delight.zh: 然后当他念完、睁开眼睛环顾四周时，全场顿时爆发出一阵欢呼，每个人都欣喜若狂，半是欢笑，半是泪水。

delight.en: The king was so delighted that he gave the puppeteer a gold chain and medal worth twenty-five pounds, which works out at something like five thousand Euros in today's money.
delight.zh: 国王非常高兴，赏赐给这位木偶艺人一条价值二十五英镑的金链和奖章，折合现在的货币大约相当于五千欧元。

description.en: If there was a job description, it would only have two “must do” items on it.
description.zh: 如果要写一份工作职责，上面大概只有两项“必须要做”的事。

description.en: I’ll put a link in the description so you can find them easily.
description.zh: 我会在简介里放一个链接，这样你们就能轻松找到它们。

description.en: I’ll put a link in the description so you can just click on that and go straight there.
description.zh: 我会在简介里放一个链接，这样你只要点一下就能直接过去了。

description.en: What is clear is the cast list, because most of these characters appear again and again in earlier descriptions.
description.zh: 清晰明确的是演员名单，因为这些角色在早期的描述中反复出现。

description.en: Sellers could upload pictures of their goods, a description of what was for sale, and the price, payable in Bitcoin.
description.zh: 卖家可以上传商品图片、商品描述以及价格，并支持用比特币支付。

devote.en: I'm devoted to setting the stage to allow it to happen.
devote.zh: 我致力于搭建舞台，让它能够发生。

devote.en: He was devoted to his wife, and a loyal husband.
devote.zh: 他深爱妻子，是个忠诚的丈夫。

devote.en: So, this is what we're devoting our program to today.
devote.zh: 所以，这就是我们今天节目的主题。

devote.en: I mean something to occupy my time. I can either devote myself to doing magic or devote myself to doing music.
devote.zh: 我指的是占据我时间的事情。我要么全身心投入做魔术，要么全身心投入做音乐。

devote.en: So, it's a tragedy that a man of that talent had to devote so much of it to being allowed to do what he could do.
devote.zh: 所以说，这真是一场悲剧——一个如此有才华的人，竟不得不把大量才干耗费在“争取获准去做他本可以做的事”这件事本身上。

deem.en: He says, “I deem him one of the greatest beings alive in our time.
deem.zh: 他说：“我认为他是我们这个时代最伟大的生命之一。

deem.en: Willis also chains the king to his chair when he deems it necessary.
deem.zh: Willis 还认为必要时将国王用链子锁在椅子上。

deem.en: It’s a story about a famous British author whose book was deemed so incendiary, so blasphemous, that the Supreme Leader of Iran issued a death sentence against him and he had to go into hiding for 10 years.
deem.zh: 这是一个关于一位英国知名作家的故事，他的书被认为具有极大的煽动性、对神明极不敬，以至于伊朗最高领袖对下达了死刑令，迫使他隐匿长达 10 年之久。

delusion.en: The delusions. The grandiosity. The weeks of extreme agitation followed by periods of relative normality.
delusion.zh: 妄想。夸大狂。数周的极端狂躁，随之而来的是相对正常的时期。

deposit.en: Beneath the DRC lies enormous deposits of copper, cobalt, gold, diamonds, tin, and coltan.
deposit.zh: 刚果（金）地下蕴藏着巨额的铜、钴、黄金、钻石、锡和钶钽铁矿储量。

deposit.en: It’s in the Pacific. And it has significant deposits of nickel, which is an important mineral used in various industries.
deposit.zh: 它位于太平洋。而且它拥有大量的镍矿储量，这是一种用于各种工业的重要矿物。

deposit.en: New Caledonia has enormous deposits of nickel, and the surrounding oceans provide fishing resources and other marine resources as well.
deposit.zh: 新喀里多尼亚拥有巨额的镍矿储量，周围的海洋也提供了渔业资源和其他海洋资源。

deposit.en: But, deep beneath the forests where its famous red crabs live, the British discovered enormous deposits of something called phosphate.
deposit.zh: 但是，在其著名的红蟹栖息的森林深处，英国人发现了巨大的矿藏，一种叫做磷酸盐的物质。

deposit.en: Increasingly, the only way young people can afford to buy is with help from parents - money for a deposit, co-signing mortgages, sometimes buying outright.
deposit.zh: 越来越明显的是，年轻人唯一买得起房子的途径就是得到父母的帮助——提供首付资金、共同签署房贷，有时甚至直接买断。

depth.en: He attempted to answer the question of the ocean’s depth.
depth.zh: 他试图回答海洋深度的问题。

depth.en: Sure, that is very impressive, but it really is only a tiny fraction of the depth of the ocean.
depth.zh: 当然，这非常令人印象深刻，但它真的只是海洋深度的一小部分。

depth.en: They recognize that somebody might be saying one thing but feeling another, and that that needs to be explored in depth.
depth.zh: 他们能意识到，有人嘴上说的是一回事，心里感受到的却是另一回事，而这一点需要被进一步探究。

depth.en: Compared to the other scientists I’ve talked about in this series, I think Turing stands out for the depth of his impact.
depth.zh: 与我在本系列中谈到的其他科学家相比，我认为 Turing 因其深远的影响而脱颖而出。

depth.en: The depth of human sleep, tied to memory, learning, creativity, and health, may itself be, in part, a consequence of learning to manage fire.
depth.zh: 人类睡眠的深度与记忆、学习、创造力以及健康息息相关，这本身或许部分就是学会掌控火的结果。

deputy.en: As town marshal, he could appoint deputies, and he hired family.
deputy.zh: 作为镇治安官，他有权任命副手，于是他雇用了自己的家人。

deputy.en: First in Wichita and then in Dodge City, both in Kansas, where he served as a deputy marshal.
deputy.zh: 先是在堪萨斯州的威奇托(Wichita)，后来又在道奇城(Dodge City)，他在那里担任副警长(deputy marshal)。

define.en: A country, as we understand it today, is a political entity with clearly defined borders.
define.zh: 正如我们今天所理解的那样，国家是一个具有清晰划定边界的政治实体。

define.en: Through this model, Turing defined computation as the act of carrying out logical steps mechanically.
define.zh: 通过这个模型，Turing 将计算定义为机械化执行逻辑步骤的行为。

define.en: Because usually like that, and what's interesting is like, you can define commitment by eliminating alternatives.
define.zh: 因为通常像那样，有趣的是，你可以通过排除其他选项来定义承诺。

define.en: What do you think is “the right” way to define who becomes a citizen or not?
define.zh: 你认为定义谁能或不能成为公民的“正确”方式是什么？

define.en: What he found was a movement that was full of ambition but lacking a defined strategy.
define.zh: 他发现这是一场充满雄心但缺乏明确战略的运动。

deflect.en: He is a Comorian now, he says. He deflects questions about the coup, about his mercenary past and about the true nature of his authority.
deflect.zh: 他说他现在是个科摩罗人。他巧妙回避了关于政变、关于他雇佣兵过去以及关于他权力的真实本质等问题。

deflect.en: You know, went past the spinal cord all the way through and then hit her cheekbone, which then deflected the bullet and then went out of her nose.
deflect.zh: 你知道，穿过了脊髓，一直穿过去，然后击中了她的颧骨，这使子弹偏转，然后从她的鼻子里出去了。

decree.en: It is a direct challenge. If the decree goes through, Denard loses his military dominance over the islands.
decree.zh: 这是直接的挑战。如果法令生效，Bob Denard 将失去对这些岛屿的军事主导权。

decree.en: He signs a decree ordering the Presidential Guard to be disarmed and integrated into the regular armed forces.
decree.zh: 他签署了一项法令，下令缴械总统卫队并将其并入国家正规武装部队。

decree.en: It looks like, if you look at it, that someone must have decreed that this should be-- God's will-- God's will.
decree.zh: 从表面上看，好像一定有谁下令规定了事情就该如此——是神的旨意——是神的旨意。

decree.en: He overreached. In November of 2012, he issued a decree giving himself near-absolute power, claiming it was temporary to protect the revolution from the judiciary, which he believed was still loyal to the old regime.
decree.zh: 他用力过猛。在 2012 年 11 月，他颁布了一项法令，赋予自己近乎绝对的权力，声称这是临时的，旨在保护革命免受司法机构的影响，他认为司法机构仍然忠于旧政权。

deny.en: Ted Kaczynski never denied being The Unabomber, but his legal defense was complicated.
deny.zh: 泰德·卡钦斯基从未否认自己是 The Unabomber，但他的法律辩护很复杂。

deny.en: It's a great option for those families and those kids, and I don't deny that.
deny.zh: 对于那些家庭和孩子来说，这是一个绝佳的选择，我并不否认这一点。

deny.en: It's an embarrassment, reported on by journalists, criticised in the European press, and impossible to deny.
deny.zh: 它成了一件丑闻，被记者报道，遭欧洲媒体批评，而且根本无法抵赖。

deny.en: It's an intellectual yet idiot. These are people who are overeducated and they deny like basic common sense.
deny.zh: 它是指“知识分子但白痴”。这些人受过过度教育，却否定基本的常识。

deny.en: Now, I should add that he always denied this, and his daughter vehemently denied it in a book from 2021.
deny.zh: 我应该补充一点，他始终否认这一点，他的女儿在 2021 年出版的一本书中也极力否认。

defendant.en: In January 2022, four defendants appear before a jury at Bristol Crown Court, charged with criminal damage.
defendant.zh: 2022年1月，四名被告出现在布里斯托尔刑事法院的陪审团面前，被控刑事毁坏罪。

defendant.en: Critics, however, argued that this looked uncomfortably close to jurors overriding the law because they sympathised with the defendants.
defendant.zh: 然而，批评者则认为，这看起来太像是陪审员因为同情被告，而凌驾于法律之上，让人感到不安。

deliberate.en: This was a deliberate decision. It kept the peace between branches of the family.
deliberate.zh: 这是一个深思熟虑的决定。它维系了王室各支派之间的和平。

deliberate.en: That’s recognition in action. It comes from decades of deliberate practice.
deliberate.zh: 这就是行动中的认知。它来自于几十年的刻意练习。

deliberate.en: In other words: a new blasphemy law. The timing was deliberate.
deliberate.zh: 换句话说：一项新的亵渎法。这个时机是刻意挑选的。

deliberate.en: My hope is simply make steady and deliberate progress.
deliberate.zh: 我的期望仅仅是取得稳步且坚定的进步。

deliberate.en: That’s called deliberate practice. Deliberate practice means doing something slightly beyond your current level and thinking carefully about how to improve.
deliberate.zh: 这被称为刻意练习。刻意练习意味着做一些略超你当前水平的事情，并仔细思考如何改进。

desirable.en: These cities are hemmed in by geography, and the most desirable areas are already built up.
desirable.zh: 这些城市受地理条件限制，最理想的区域已经完全开发完毕了。

desirable.en: Some tulips were rare or had broken colors caused by a virus, which made them even more desirable.
desirable.zh: 有些郁金香非常稀有，或者拥有由病毒引起的破色花纹，这使得它们更加抢手。

desirable.en: For centuries, humans have known that choosing animals or plants with desirable traits like bigger cows or sweeter apples or faster horses, and then breeding them can change future generations.
desirable.zh: 几个世纪以来，人类一直知道，选择具有理想特征的动植物——比如更大的奶牛、更甜的苹果或跑得更快的马——然后进行繁育，就能改变后代。

desirable.en: As long as housing is seen as one of the safest places to park wealth, as long as there's more capital looking for safe returns than there are good investment opportunities, as long as people continue to move to towns and cities, and as long as we don't build enough homes in desirable locations, prices will keep climbing.
desirable.zh: 只要住房被视为藏匿财富最安全的地方之一，只要寻找安全回报的资本多于好的投资机会，只要人们继续向城镇和城市迁移，只要我们没有在理想的地点建造足够的房屋，价格就会继续攀升。

descendant.en: There were French-speaking Canadians who were the descendants of the settlers of New France.
descendant.zh: 有作为新法兰西定居者后代的法裔加拿大人。

descendant.en: Today, Rapa Nui is home to around 8,000 people, many of whom are descendants of the original inhabitants.
descendant.zh: 如今，Rapa Nui 居住着大约8000人，其中许多人都是最初居民的后代。

descendant.en: Most residents are descendants of Chinese or Malay or Singaporean workers who were originally brought to the island for mining.
descendant.zh: 大多数居民是最初为了采矿而被带到岛上的中国、马来西亚或新加坡工人的后代。

descendant.en: And with hundreds of princes and thousands of descendants, that could have led to an immediate, and possibly violent, power struggle.
descendant.zh: 面对数百名王子和数千名后代，这可能会引发一场直接的、甚至是暴力的权力斗争。

descendant.en: Many long-term inhabitants, often the descendants of the original Chinese and Malay laborers, were forcibly repatriated, forcibly deported, to Singapore or Malaysia or China.
descendant.zh: 许多长期居民，通常是中国和马来西亚原住民劳工的后代，被强行遣返，强行驱逐出境到新加坡、马来西亚或中国。

detain.en: They even manage to detain Joseph Goebbels, the Nazi propaganda chief, in his Berlin office.
detain.zh: 他们甚至设法在柏林办公室里扣押了纳粹宣传头子约瑟夫·戈培尔（Joseph Goebbels）。

detain.en: The message was unmistakable. If he could detain princes and billionaires at will, there was nobody he couldn’t touch.
detain.zh: 释放的信号毋庸置疑。如果他能随心所欲地拘留王子和亿万富翁，那就没有什么人是他动不了的。

detain.en: So when he is detained by Major Otto Ernst Remer, a commanding officer of the reserve troops, Goebbels puts Hitler on the line.
detain.zh: 因此，当他被预备役部队指挥官奥托·恩斯特·雷默（Otto Ernst Remer）少校扣押时，戈培尔直接把希特勒的电话接了进来。

detain.en: Among those detained was Prince Alwaleed bin Talal, the so-called Warren Buffet of Arabia, one of the most recognisable Saudi billionaires, a man with major shareholdings in big American technology companies.
detain.zh: 被拘留者中包括阿尔瓦利德·本·塔拉尔亲王，被称为“阿拉伯的沃伦·巴菲特”，他是沙特最知名的亿万富翁之一，在许多美国大型科技公司拥有大量股份。

detain.en: Mubarak used the threat of Islamic extremism to continue the country’s “state of emergency”, which gave the state heightened powers to arrest, detain, and question if there was even the tiniest inkling of wrongdoing, and in many cases, even if there wasn’t.
detain.zh: Mubarak 利用伊斯兰极端主义的威胁来延续国家的“紧急状态”，这赋予了国家更大的权力去逮捕、拘留和审讯那些哪怕只有一丝一毫违法苗头的人，在许多情况下，甚至连这种苗头都没有也不放过。

despise.en: The connection was technology; these were people Kaczynski believed were responsible for advancing the technological society he so despised.
despise.zh: 唯一的联系就是技术；这些人都是卡钦斯基认为应对推进他所鄙视的技术社会负责的人。

definite.en: His mum shrugged and said she didn’t really know why he said this, and it seems like there is no definite answer to what it means.
definite.zh: 他妈妈耸耸肩，说她也不太清楚他为什么会这么说，看起来这个词到底是什么意思，确实没有一个明确的答案。

definite.en: What they found was a definite trend: the more likely someone thought someone else was to do them a good deed, such as returning their lost wallet, the more likely they were to say that they were happy.
definite.zh: 他们发现了一个明确的趋势：一个人越是认为别人会对自己做善事（比如归还他们丢失的钱包），他们就越倾向于说自己是快乐的。

derive.en: It argued that governments derive their powers from the consent of the governed.
derive.zh: 它认为政府的权力源于被统治者的同意。

derive.en: Chronic is derived from the Greek “kronos” and means “related to time”.
derive.zh: “chronic”源自希腊语“kronos”，意思是“与时间相关的”。

derive.en: So, Grameenphone is a expression of an understanding derived from theory, and a successful one.

deceive.en: Secondly, if you have two decisions, if you have A or B, and both seem like very equal, take the path that's more painful in the short term the one that's going to be painful immediately because your brain is always trying to avoid pain so any pain that is imminent it is going to treat as much larger than it actually is this is kind of like a decision-making equivalent of taleb surgeon uh taleb surgeon whether you want the surgeon doesn't look as good because he's more likely to be a good surgeon yeah it's similar in that appearances are deceiving because you're avoiding conflict you're avoiding pain so take the path that's more painful in the short term because your brain is creating this illusion that the short-term pain is greater than the long-term pain because long-term yeah you'll commit your future self to all kinds of long-term exactly so take the more short-term painful one and then finally the last one which i would try to couple gupta with uh is that you want to take it take the choice that will leave you more equanimous in the long term by quantumus he means like more peace more mental peace in the long term.
deceive.zh: 其次，如果你有两个选择，A或B，而且看起来不相上下，那就选择短期内更痛苦的那条路，也就是会立即带来痛苦的那条，因为你的大脑总是试图逃避痛苦，所以任何迫在眉睫的痛苦在它看来都会被放大，这有点像Nassim Taleb所说的决策等价物，比如你为什么不想找一个看起来不够好的外科医生，因为他可能反而是一位好医生，是的，这很相似，因为表象往往具有欺骗性，你在逃避冲突，逃避痛苦，所以选择短期内更痛苦的那条路，因为你的大脑制造了一种幻觉，让你觉得短期痛苦比长期痛苦更严重，因为从长远来看，你会把未来的自己投入到各种长期的承诺中，没错，所以选择短期更痛苦的那一个，最后一点，我想结合Gupta的观点，那就是你要选择那个能让你在长期内保持内心平静的选择，所谓“内心平静”是指更平和、更安宁。
